intro: Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-09-12, ZCyberNews published 46 articles tagged data-breach. The coverage spans incidents affecting government, healthcare, education, retail, and technology, with victims reported across North America, Europe, the United States, France, and globally. ShinyHunters, LockBit, and Cl0p appear among the top threat actors in this tag. Of the 46 articles, 38 are rated high severity and 6 medium. The archive documents breach activity throughout the five-month period, tracking the sectors and regions most frequently named in reporting and the actors most often linked to the incidents covered.
